test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The crime scene __were surround__ by yellow tape.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e. **"was surrounded".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence,** "The crime scene"** is a **singular noun** and thus, it requires a singular verb to agree with it.
 
• The **correct form of the verb** to be used here is **"was"**, not "w
